rephrased_query: Работает ли Obsidian без подключения к интернету
expected_answer: Obsidian is an offline-first app and can be used without internet; internet is only needed for cloud sync, updates, downloads, and some online services.

rephrased_query: Does an опубликованный site collect visitor cookies?
expected_answer: Published sites do not collect visitor cookies by themselves; cookies may be set by embedded third-party services or custom scripts.

rephrased_query: How many people can be added to a shared vault?
expected_answer: A shared vault can include up to 5 members.

rephrased_query: графики и связи на сайте Publish
expected_answer: В Obsidian Publish можно публиковать граф, если он включён для опубликованного сайта.

rephrased_query: Lockdown Mode on Apple devices in Obsidian
expected_answer: Lockdown Mode reduces the attack surface on Apple devices and can affect Obsidian features that rely on certain web content or services.
